name: Speech Analytics Dashboards
start: cd /workspace; if ! curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8000/; then nohup python3 -m http.server 8000 >/tmp/static-server.log 2>&1 & fi; for i in $(seq 1 15); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8000/ && break; sleep 1; done; curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8000/ && echo 'static server ready on http://localhost:8000' || echo 'ERROR: static server failed to start'
